01 / Context

The problem

Application UI and logic changes can break large inventories of automated tests during quarterly or yearly regression runs. Investigating those breakages and updating scripts creates recurring maintenance work.

My contribution

Backend development focused on orchestration logic and pipeline development, using custom Python scripts and LangChain as the decision framework for synchronous orchestration.

02 / Workflow

From input to outcome

  1. Detect a broken script

    A script breakage triggers the maintenance workflow.

  2. Correlate defect reports

    The Auto Defect Management system supplies confirmed reports as application-change signals.

  3. Orchestrate a repair

    Custom Python and LangChain coordinate the synchronous maintenance workflow.

  4. Update the test code

    The workflow produces script changes intended to address the breakage.

03 / Architecture

Implementation boundaries

Decision and orchestration layer

Custom Python scripts use LangChain for decision-making within a synchronous orchestration pipeline.

Defect workflow bridge

The pipeline connects with Auto Defect Management to use confirmed reports as change signals for test maintenance.

Tracing and observability

LangSmith provides LLM tracing, alongside OpenTelemetry for observability.

Development tooling

GitHub Copilot supports development alongside the Python and LangChain implementation.

  • Python
  • LangChain
  • LangSmith
  • OpenTelemetry
  • GitHub Copilot

04 / Engineering decisions

Controls and trade-offs

Connect maintenance to diagnostic context

The script workflow consumes confirmed reports from the defect-management integration rather than treating a broken script as an isolated event.

Keep the execution model explicit

Custom Python scripts and LangChain coordinate implementation through synchronous orchestration.

Trace the orchestration

LangSmith tracing and OpenTelemetry observability accompany the decision and orchestration pipeline.
